name: Veil Masquerade #09
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Discs. Aperture: None. Ornament: Chevrons. Palette: Teal. Hem: Beaded fringe. Its aperture is the only one of its kind in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
